subject: [hw] V40 -> V41: one new n2vcu.h symbol (n2vcu_ap_set_log) and one stats field; no existing API change
body:
Rev 4 of vcu/n2vcu.{c,h} fixes the leads GET_LOG finding. API impact on your package:

- new: int n2vcu_ap_set_log(struct n2vcu *vcu, const char *text); the AP side of vcu_set_log() (mtk_vcu.c:2113-2145): stores text (truncated to 1023 + NUL), sets vdec_log_got, wakes a daemon blocked in VCU_GET_LOG_OBJECT. Returns 0, -EINVAL for NULL. Nothing in your path needs to call it (nothing sets a log on the phone).
- struct n2vcu_stats has a new field log_blocked (calls currently blocked inside GET_LOG) after log_waits. Named-field access only; your n2vcu_standin.c memset(0) + three assignments still compiles and behaves the same.
- VCU_GET_LOG_OBJECT now blocks instead of returning at once; no other ioctl, allocation, GCE, mmap or IPI behaviour changed; request numbers/layouts untouched.
Your vcu/test_v41 suite does not call GET_LOG, so no change is needed. If you keep the standin in sync, an n2vcu_ap_set_log() stub returning -EINVAL for NULL / storing nothing would keep the two implementations symbol-compatible; only needed if a future test references it.
Tests here: N2TEST V40 PASS 1377/1377 (459 x asan/o2/tsan); your real-n2vcu t_v41 binary links the same file and should be unaffected.
